name: _music.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  space-playground/_music.scss — the native audio player bar aligned with the nav.
//  Imported by space-playground.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Native audio player bar aligned with nav ─────────────────────────────────

// Music toggle button.
.#{$_B_SP}-music {
  @extend %MAXAREA;

  position: absolute;
  bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
  left: 0;
  z-index: 10;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  pointer-events: none;

  audio {
    pointer-events: auto;
    height: to-rem($space-2xl);
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    opacity: 0.85;
    transition: opacity 0.2s ease;

    &:hover,
    &:focus {
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }
}
